<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a strong monoisotopic peak at m/z ≈ 233.96, with a companion peak ≈ 2 Da higher at m/z ≈ 235.96 having about 25 % of the intensity of the monoisotopic peak—this matches the characteristic 3:1 (≈75 % : 25 %) M : M+2 pattern of chlorine. No other element shows a definitive, distinctive isotopic signature in the spectrum. Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
